id.description: One word; must equal the file name without .json

title.description: The name in the journal and tracker

giver.description: A person id, role:<role>, or none

start.description: The id of the first step

steps.description: One entry per step, keyed by step id

objective.description: talk, goto, gather, give, craft, interact, defeat, wait or flag, with its words

hint.description: Shown after this long without progress

branches.description: [{ if, to }]: the first true one is taken instead of next

fail.description: When any holds, the quest fails for good

rewards.description: Effect lines run when the quest ends

journal.description: The line shown for a finished quest
